1 · Intro

When to use it.

Student Expense Only is the setup for a student who needs to be reimbursed for expenses. It is not a way to pay the student for work.

Because no work is performed for pay, this setup needs no I-9 and no background check.

Use this whenA student needs to be reimbursed for expenses (for example, travel) and has no paid role.

2 · Walk through

What to know.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Never use Student Expense Only to pay a student for services. That needs a student worker setup and an I-9.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's Student Expense Only setup in Oracle (worker type, person type, hire reason, assignment status, and end date) is not yet documented.
  • Open item: Who owns approving Student Expense Only records and how reimbursements route (HCM, finance partner, or another office).

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Work Relationships (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Where do person types come from? (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Student Expense Only

Use when: A student needs to be reimbursed for expenses (for example, travel) and has no paid role. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Confirm the student only needs expense reimbursement, not pay.
  2. Search the student in Our Workforce > Employment Info before you add anything.
  3. Set up the Student Expense Only record as your area's process directs.
  4. Skip the I-9 and background check for this setup.

Watch-outs

  • Never use Student Expense Only to pay a student for services. That needs a student worker setup and an I-9.
  • Open item: Vanderbilt's Student Expense Only setup in Oracle (worker type, person type, hire reason, assignment status, and end date) is not yet documented.
  • Open item: Who owns approving Student Expense Only records and how reimbursements route (HCM, finance partner, or another office).
